name: relay
title: Relay
description: Browse your Relay library, fetch TorBox CDN links, and launch videos directly in your local player.
author: relay

commands.name: relay
commands.title: Relay
commands.description: Browse Movies, Shows, and Other files, fetch CDN links, and play videos

commands.name: configure-player
commands.title: Configure Relay Player
commands.description: Configure your local video player binary path and playback settings

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Relay Server URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Relay instance (default: https://relay.kshiyo.dpdns.org)

preferences.name: playerPath
preferences.title: Player Binary / App Path
preferences.description: Path to your video player binary or .app bundle (e.g. /Applications/IINA.app, /opt/homebrew/bin/mpv)

preferences.name: playerArgs
preferences.title: Extra Player Arguments
preferences.description: Optional CLI arguments passed to the player (use {url} to place the CDN link manually)

preferences.name: resumePlayback
preferences.title: Resume from Saved Position
preferences.description: Pass a start timestamp flag when launching supported CLI players (mpv, iina-cli, vlc)
preferences.label: Resume from last watched position
